title: Dan Cyn Studio
specs: Classes available for Ages 18 months to Adult
Hair must be worn back during all classes
Dance attire required: leotard or dance shorts or skirt with top; socks or tights with tap shoes; no street clothing
Combo classes require moveable dance attire, jazz pants, dance shorts and stretch tops; jazz/tap shoes
Jazz & Tap classes require moveable dance attire, clean tennis shoes, jazz shoes or hip-hop sneakers
Hip-Hop class requires black leotard, pink ballet tights, ballet shoes; hair must be worn in a bun

blurb: Dancyn Studio offers dance classes for ages 18 months to adult, covering beginner to professional levels. Classes include styles such as Jazz, Tap, Hip Hop, Contemporary, Acro, Ballet, and Pointe. They also have performance and company classes for more advanced dancers.
extraNote: No food or gum in studio · No tap shoes in the lobby · No diaper changing in the lobby · Non-flavored bottled water only · No hanging on the bars · No running
